options.text: What do you do around here?

steps.player: What do you do around here?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: I'm a Town Crier. It's my job to let people know of any recent news. After all, there's all sorts of things happening around here.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Until next time.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Until next time.

historical-dialogue-regular-players.speaker: Town crier
historical-dialogue-regular-players.text: Hear ye! Hear ye! Player Moderators massive help to RuneSc-

historical-dialogue-regular-players.speaker: Town crier
historical-dialogue-regular-players.text: Oh, hello citizen. Are you here to find out about Player Moderators? Or perhaps would you like to know about the laws of the land?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Of course. What would you like to know?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Player Moderators are normal players of the game, just like you. However, since they have shown themselves to be trustworthy and active reporters, they have been invited by Jagex to monitor the game and

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: take appropriate action when they see rule breaking. You can spot a Player Moderator in game by looking at the chat screen - when a Player Moderator speaks, a silver crown appears to the left of their name.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Remember, if there's not silver crown there, they are not a Player Moderator!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Is there anything else you'd like to know?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Player Moderators, or 'P-mods', have the ability to mute rule breakers and Jagex view their reports as a priority so that action is taken as quickly as possible. P- Mods also have access to the Player Moderator Centre.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Within the Centre are tools to help them Moderate Old School RuneScape. These tools include dedicated forums, the Player Moderator Guidelines and the Player Moderator Code of Conduct.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Is there anything else you'd like to know?

options.text: How do I become a Player Moderator?

steps.player: How do I become a Player Moderator?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Jagex picks players who spend their time and effort to help better the Old School RuneScape community. To increase your chances of becoming a Player Moderator:

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Keep your account secure! This is very important, as a player with poor security will never be a P-Mod. Read our Security Tips for more information.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Play by the rules! The rules of Old School RuneScape are enforced for a reason, to make the game a fair and enjoyable environment for all.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Report accurately! When Jagex consider an account for review they look for quality, not quantity. Ensure your reports are of a high quality by following the report guidelines.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Be excellent to each other! Treat others as you would want to be treated yourself. Respect your fellow player.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Is there anything else you'd like to know?

options.text: What can Player Moderators not do?

steps.player: What can Player Moderators not do?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: P-Mods cannot ban your account - they can only report offences. Jagex then take action based on the evidence received. If you lose your password or get scammed by another player, P-Mods cannot help you

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: get your account back. All they can do is recommend you to go to Customer Support. They cannot retrieve any items you may have lost and receive no free items from Jagex for helping moderate the game. They are

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: players who give their efforts to help the community out of the goodness of their hearts! P-mods do not work for Jagex and so cannot make you a Moderator, or recommend other accounts to become moderators. If

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: you wish to become a Moderator, please feel free to ask me how!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Is there anything else you'd like to know?

options.text: Tell me about the Rules of Conduct.

steps.player: Tell me about the Rules of Conduct.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: At once. Take a look at my book here...

options.text: Can you give me a handy tip please?

steps.player: Can you give me a handy tip please?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Did you know most skills have right click 'Make-X' options to help you train faster?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Make your recovery questions and answers hard to guess but easy to remember.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Don't use your RuneScape password on other sites. Keep your account safe!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: If you think someone knows your password - change it!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: The squirrels! The squirrels are coming! Noooo, get them out of my head!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Did you know you burn food less often on the range in Lumbridge castle than other ranges?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Players can not trim armour. Don't fall for this popular scam!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: If you're lost and have no idea where to go, use the Home Teleport spell for free!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: If you see someone breaking the rules, report them!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Did you know? Superheat Item means you never fail to smelt ore!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Did you know that at high levels of Runecrafting you get more than one rune per essence?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Never lend your items out unless you expect them not to come back.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Never question a penguin.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Melee armour actually gives you disadvantages when using magic attacks. It may be better to take off your armour entirely!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Take time to check the second trade window carefully. Don't be scammed!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Did you know having a bank pin can help secure your valuable items?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Did you know that mithril equipment is very light?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: There are no cheats in RuneScape! Never visit websites promising otherwise!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Jagex will never e-mail you. Do not believe any e-mails that claim to be from us.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: If you're stuck on a skill, talk to the Lumbridge Tutors for help and tips.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Did you know that you can wear a shield with a crossbow?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Beware of players trying to lure you into the wilderness. Your items cannot be returned if you lose them!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Never tell your password to anyone, not even your best friend!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Be careful when fighting wizards! Wearing heavy armour can lower your Magic resistance!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Is there anything else you'd like to know?

historical-dialogue-player-moderators.speaker: Town crier
historical-dialogue-player-moderators.text: Hear ye! Hear ye! Player Moderators massive help to Rune... Oh great, a P-mod! I know all about the great job you guys do, would you like me to prove my extensive knowledge to you?!

options.text: Can you show me the Guidelines please?

steps.player: Can you show me the Guidelines please?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Of course, but I can't let you keep it - I've only got a few copies!

options.text: Do you have a copy of the Code of Conduct?

steps.player: Do you have a copy of the Code of Conduct?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Oh yes, but I can't let you keep it - I've only a few copies!

options.text: Can you give me a moderating tip please?

steps.player: Can you give me a moderating tip please?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Add other Player Moderators to your friends list for quick advice and moral support in-game. It does help!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: To avoid reporting the wrong player, add an offender to your friends list, switch your public chat to friends and then use your right-click report from there. Easy!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Did you know that Free-to-Play P-mods CAN visit the moderator forums, by logging into the regular forums at the top right hand side of the forum screen, despite it saying Members only.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Don't be tempted to report anything you didn't see, no matter how much you trust the player who is informing you.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Don't eat something messy when on a first date - it won't look good!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Don't forget to add the mute if needed, before selecting the report category. This cuts down on those duplicate reports for one player.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: The forums are the best place to keep abreast of any procedure changes that might not yet be included in the Player Mod guidelines!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Got players asking you to unban them or help them retrieve a stolen or hacked account? There's nothing you can do so just send them to the Customer Support Team. If they think you can help, send them to me; I'll

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: put them straight!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Have the P-Mod Oracle open in a separate window when playing Old School RuneScape - that way you'll always have the most up-to-date guidelines to hand!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: If the chat is scrolling too fast for you to see that suspect line you want to double check, just run up a ladder or to a quieter spot to stop the chat screen scrolling. Then you can scroll back and read that

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: suspect line and judge the situation in your own time!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: If you're a new mod, don't forget to read the guidelines before you log into the game! If you've been a P-mod for a while, why not have another read of them to refresh your memory and to get up to date

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: with any changes you may have missed!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: If you've got a player asking you questions about P- mods, feel free to send them to me; I can answer questions about P-mods for you!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: If you get harassed by a player in game, don't take it personally - the player is reacting to your silver crown, not to you!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: If you notice a player trying to buy something common for an extremely high price, look about and see if there's someone else selling the same item for a much lower price. Chances are they're team scamming. If so,

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: write their names down and send your J-mod curators a query!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: If you see a player abusing a bug in game, there's no need to report the player, just submit a bug report via the in-game report form.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: An important part of being a P-mod is to act as an ambassador for the game. Keeping your cool even when faced with the rudest players goes a long way towards this!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: It's always better to report in secret. Telling a player that you are about to report them rarely makes you a friend, and can often lead to a player being offensive to you!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Make sure you log out of the game and the forums whenever you leave your device. Don't allow others to see confidential info!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Never answer questions if you feel the answer will breach confidentiality.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: The P-mod forums are your friend! They're the best place to talk to and meet other P-mods and are absolutely packed with useful advice!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Remember, if in doubt, report without a mute! It's very frustrating not to be able to speak if you're innocent!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Remember, if offensive language has been completely filtered out then there's no need to report or mute it!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Think twice before applying that mute. Will it really prevent further damage from surrounding players?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Use the Jagex PMod team if you need to - they're there to help!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: You'll be amazed how often a bit of humour can diffuse a potentially unpleasant situation, before it becomes too serious.

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Your J-mods are there to help you. If you ever need their advice, send them a query. They are always very happy to help. Don't be afraid to use them!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Your Player Moderator identity must never be revealed on the regular Old School RuneScape forums. However, you're more than welcome to chat about all aspects of being a Player Moderator in the official

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Player Moderator forums!

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Is there anything else you'd like to know?

options.text: What help do you give to non Player Moderators?

steps.player: You're very helpful to us Player Moderators, but what help do you give to non Player Moderators?

steps.speaker: Town crier
steps.text: Well now, let me see...

options.text: Tell me about the Rules of Conduct.
Can you give me a handy tip please?
